patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs next to Samsung's own Messages on Galaxy phones under its own package name.

options.description: Must be a valid Android package name.

patches.name: Charged SMS and roaming confirmation alert
patches.description: Shows a One UI confirmation dialog before sending an SMS that will incur extra charges (international SMS or roaming outside EU/RLAH).

patches.name: Disable SMS to MMS conversion
patches.description: Sends long text messages as multi-part SMS instead of automatically converting them to MMS.
